Theme

Computing & programming

commit verb and noun

version control

* our formation

1cōnsignō, cōnsignātiō: short i before gn (some older dictionaries lengthen it). That reading is disputed; no general rule of vowel lengthening before gn is applied here. Ruling: Short vowels before gn.

* (our own formation) cōnsignō1, cōnsignāre, cōnsignāvī, cōnsignātum

verb, first conjugation

seal or record

Applied here to committing a version. The Git meaning is a working extension. Preserve commit in literal commands.

Other words

  • * (our own formation) cōnsignātiō1, cōnsignātiōnis f. — recording or registration

    noun, third declension · * our formation

    Our descriptive noun for a commit.

See also merge, code.
